title: Quirky Slovakian Pork Skewers
description: This dish features earthy flavors and a shaggy appearance with basil leaves, perfect for a low-fat friendly meal option, showcasing traditional Slovakian cuisine with a quirky twist.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and grill for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
In a small bowl, mix together lemon juice and chopped basil leaves.
Brush the lemon-basil mixture onto the skewers during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional basil leaves if desired.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
